description: This Kotlin file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application. It manages navigation, toolbar, drawer menu, intent handling for sharing and deep links, UI setup, user preferences, and includes functions for media sharing, backup, and restore functionalities.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing app navigation, drawer, deep linking, media sharing, backup, and restoring notes. Acts as the central controller for UI and navigation interactions within the app.

methods.name: copySharedMedia
methods.description: Copies a shared media file from a URI to the app's private storage and returns the new URI.

methods.name: handleIntent
methods.description: Processes incoming intents for sharing content, deep links, creating new notes, or opening specific notes.

methods.name: setupNavigation
methods.description: Initializes navigation, drawer menu, and notebook list management.

methods.name: startBackup
methods.description: Starts backup of notes to a specified URI.

methods.name: restoreNotes
methods.description: Restores notes from a specified backup URI.
